title: Create FilterToolbar Component with Search and Basic Filters
description: Build a comprehensive client component that provides search, status filtering, and sorting capabilities for schedule events with URL state synchronization.
details: Create `components/dashboard/FilterToolbar.tsx` as a client component using shadcn/ui components. Implement a search input with debouncing using a custom `useDebounce` hook, status filter dropdown, sort options dropdown, and view toggle (List/Kanban). Use `useSearchParams` to read initial state from URL and `useRouter` to update query parameters. Include proper TypeScript interfaces for filter state and ensure all interactive elements have appropriate ARIA labels for accessibility.
test_strategy: Unit test the debounce hook functionality and component state management. Test URL synchronization by verifying query parameters update correctly when filters change. Component test to ensure proper rendering of all filter elements and their interactions.

title: Implement Date Range Filter with Calendar Component
description: Add advanced date range filtering capability using a popover calendar interface for selecting start and end dates.
details: Extend the FilterToolbar component to include a date range filter using shadcn/ui's `Popover` and `Calendar` components. Implement date selection logic that allows users to pick start and end dates, with proper validation to ensure start date is before end date. Use date-fns for date manipulation and formatting. Store date range in URL query parameters as ISO strings and provide clear visual feedback for selected date ranges with reset functionality.
test_strategy: Test date selection logic, validation rules, and URL parameter serialization/deserialization. Verify calendar component renders correctly in both light and dark themes. Test edge cases like invalid date ranges and timezone handling.

title: Create Server Action for Dynamic Data Fetching
description: Implement server-side logic to fetch filtered, sorted, and searched schedule events from PostgreSQL using Drizzle ORM with dynamic query building.
details: Create `lib/actions/scheduleEvents.ts` with a Server Action that accepts filter parameters (search query, status, date range, sort field, sort direction) and builds dynamic Drizzle queries. Implement conditional `where` clauses for text search (using ILIKE for case-insensitive search), status filtering, and date range filtering. Add dynamic `orderBy` clauses based on sort parameters. Include proper error handling, input validation using Zod schemas, and return type-safe results. Consider database performance by adding appropriate indexes for frequently queried columns.
test_strategy: Unit test query building logic with various filter combinations. Test database queries with mock data to ensure correct results. Verify error handling for invalid parameters and database connection issues. Performance test with larger datasets to ensure query efficiency.

title: Integrate FilterToolbar with Dashboard Page and Add Loading States
description: Connect the FilterToolbar component to the main dashboard page, implement data fetching based on filter state, and add proper loading and empty states.
details: Modify `app/dashboard/page.tsx` to integrate the FilterToolbar component and handle server-side data fetching based on searchParams. Implement the Server Action call with proper error boundaries and loading states. Add skeleton loaders during data fetching, empty state components when no results are found, and error states for failed requests. Ensure the page maintains server-side rendering capabilities and works with disabled JavaScript. Include proper TypeScript types for all props and state management.
test_strategy: Integration test the complete filter workflow from UI interaction to data display. Test server-side rendering with various URL parameters. Verify loading states appear and disappear correctly. Test error scenarios and empty result handling. End-to-end test using Playwright to simulate complete user workflows.
